# Spec: See what the API just did

[Specs](README.md) | [User guide](../user-guide/see-recent-traces.md)

**Start:** `/operations/telemetry`  
**Persona:** An operator checking a request  
**Goal:** List the latest traces the API sent to the dashboard and jump to one.

**Table 1 — Acceptance criteria**

| Step | Action | Expected result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Open the telemetry page | A table lists recent spans with their duration and a trace link.<br>A link opens the dashboard. |
